title.narrative: Activity under preparation Reinforce Pharma, Health Products and Technologies value chains

description.narrative: The overall objective is to strengthen the African health security architecture, pharmaceutical systems and public health capacity, contributing to stronger, more resilient health systems and improved health outcomes. This objective pursues SDG 3.8 and promotes ultimately universal health coverage (UHC).The Action has two specific objectives:1.Specific Objective 1 (50 M): aims to reinforce health sector resilience and African strategic autonomy by focusing on underserved segments of the pharmaceutical value chain. This action is the fourth EU funded regional programme formulated in the framework of the regional MAV+ initiative. It encompasses a regional level and country level interventions through two workstreams.·Country level: through a Global Gateway 360° approach, it will focus on building stronger public and private ecosystems, with special attention to supporting innovative financial solutions (indicative countries: Senegal, Ghana, Nigeria, Rwanda, South Africa, Ethiopia, Guinea Bissau and Guinea Conakry).·Regional level: will focus on 1) supporting regulatory strengthening and harmonisation, in line the African Medicines Agency mandate, 2) support establishment of regional pooled procurement mechanisms 3) support the fight against illicit drugs and 4) strengthen R&D/laboratories (indicative countries: Ethiopia, Guinea Bissau, Guinea Conakry, Burundi, DRC and Angola).2.Specific Objective 2 (5M): create a structure to support the EU-AU Health Partnership Team Europe Initiative. Following lessons learnt from the MAV+ Team Europe Support Structure (TESS), the support structure will have as main goal to ensure a coherent and coordinated approach of all interventions done under each of 5 hubs under the EU-AU Health Partnership TEI, namely MAV+, SRHR, Health Security using a One Health approach (HSOH), Public Health Institutes (PHI) and Digital Health (DH) and support the teams behind these hubs to ensure an effective implementation.This Action contributes to the Global Gateway Health Package presented at the 6th EU-AU Summit in 2022 and the EU-AU Health Partnership Team Europe Inititiave[1], which includes the Manufacturing and access to vaccines, medicines and health technologies (MAV+) hub. [1] The EU AU Health Partnership Team Europe Initiative (TEI) includes five TEI Hubs: theHub on manufacturing and access to vaccines, medicines and health technologies (MAV+), the Hub on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights, the Hub on Health Security using a One Health approach, the Hub on Digital Health and the Hub on Support to Public Health Insititutes in SSA
